description: Create an OpenAI-compatible tool adapter over the API/MCP contracts without making the calculator an LLM endpoint.

included: OpenAI-compatible function tool definitions over canonical calculator surfaces.
Examples for Responses-style and Chat Completions-style tool use.
Contract tests proving the tool definitions are parseable strict function tools and remain bound to canonical schema ownership.
Boundary documentation that prevents LLM endpoint emulation and formula logic in the adapter.
excluded: Serving the calculator as an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.
Owning calculator formula logic or business rules in the OpenAI adapter.
Live OpenAI API execution, credentials, or hosted production integration proof.

gap_register.description: The local track validates tool definitions and boundary contracts only; live model invocation and hosted integration are deployment concerns outside this adapter contract.
